author: claude

cloud_writes.object: new site QA_OFFL-001_<run> in the CT account
cloud_writes.what: creates the site (stays in the CT account; the engine does not delete) and its offline map download to the tablet
creates the flight QA_OFFL-001_<run> offline; it syncs when the tablet is back online (stays there)

expected: With OfflineSites on, a new site QA_OFFL-001_<run> created with 'Enable offline use' on downloads and shows 'Site available offline'. With the tablet's Wi-Fi off and the app offline, Create flight in that site creates the flight QA_OFFL-001_<run> ('Flight successfully created') and opens its planner, with no error. Nothing in the planner is saved.
forbidden: Save or Save & exit in the planner
Delete or archive (the QA_ site and flight stay)
any site other than the one this case creates

preconditions.text: CT account logged in on the tablet
OfflineSites on for the CT account
the tablet online at start (the case switches Wi-Fi off itself)

requirement.text:
Test cases:
-Happy path during site creation ( create a new site ) - Enable offline use through site creation 
 than go  offline, you can create a flight in this site, and check if its available.

routing.symbol: input-site-name; offline toggle behind OFFLINE_SITES on android
moveend at zoom > 10 sets the default site polygon
Create, disabled while the site's map data is missing

steps.text: Top bar: Sites
New site (opens site creation with the name field)
Site name: QA_OFFL-001_{run}
Location: type the lat/long 47.352000, 8.491000
Wait for the lat/long suggestion
Pick the lat/long suggestion: the map centres there at zoom 14 and the default site area is set

steps.helper: act.py {target} tap "text:Enable offline use" --expect "js:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=checkbox]')].some(e => { let p = e; for (let i = 0; i < 4 && p; i++) { if (/Enable offline use/.test(p.innerText || '')) return e.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true'; p = p.parentElement; } return false; })" --timeout 15
steps.text: Turn on Enable offline use
Next (storage check; goes to the coordinate system step)
Wait until Save new site is enabled (coordinate system ready)
Save new site: creates the QA_ site (cloud write) and starts its offline download

steps.helper: act.py {target} wait --expect "js:/Site available offline|Failed to make|Cannot make site available offline|Not enough storage/.test(document.body.innerText)" --timeout 300
steps.text: Wait for 'Site available offline' (up to 5 min)
Screenshot: the site after the download

assert.expr: v['download']['site_path'] is True and v['download']['available'] is True and v['download']['failed'] is False

steps.read_js: ({site_path: /^\/sites\/[0-9a-f-]{36}/.test(location.pathname), available: /Site available offline/.test(document.body.innerText), failed: /Failed to make|Cannot make site available offline|Not enough storage/.test(document.body.innerText), site_id: (location.pathname.split('/')[2] || null)})
steps.text: Check the site is available offline
Wi-Fi off on the tablet; wait until the app shows it is offline
Wait for Create flight in the empty site
Create flight (opens the New flight form)
Flight name: QA_OFFL-001_{run}
Wait until Create is enabled (disabled while the site's map data is missing)

steps.helper: act.py {target} tap text:Create --expect "js:/\/planning\/[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(location.pathname) || (window.__qaToasts || []).some(x => /Flight successfully created|went wrong|error/i.test(x))" --timeout 30
steps.text: Create: creates the QA_ flight in the new site offline (synced later; cloud write)
Wait for the planner of the new flight
Screenshot: the new flight, created offline

assert.expr: v['flight']['planner'] is True and v['flight']['error_toast'] is False and (v['flight']['created_toast'] is True or v['flight']['name_shown'] is True)

steps.read_js: ({planner: /\/planning\/[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(location.pathname), same_site: location.pathname.split('/')[1] === 'sites', created_toast: (window.__qaToasts || []).some(x => /Flight successfully created/.test(x)), error_toast: (window.__qaToasts || []).some(x => /went wrong|error/i.test(x)), offline: !navigator.onLine, name_shown: document.body.innerText.includes('QA_OFFL-001_{run}')})
steps.text: Check the flight was created offline in the new site and is open

steps.helper: act.py {target} tap testid:btn-sites --expect "js:/Exit without saving/.test(document.body.innerText) || location.pathname === '/sites'" --timeout 20
steps.text: Clean-up: leave the planner (always)
Exit without saving when asked (always; writes nothing)
Clean-up: Wi-Fi back on (always)

steps_note: Written 2026-11-03 from New test W-20261103-004 (no example case for offline sites). Online first: new QA_ site, Enable offline use, Save new site, wait for 'Site available offline'; then Wi-Fi off and a QA_ flight created offline. The site area is the app's default box at zoom 14 around 47.352000, 8.491000; if it is over the offline size limit, step 13 fails on 'Cannot make site available offline' (a test-data problem, not an app bug). Wi-Fi comes back on in step 25 (always) and the runner turns it on after any run that switched it off.

supersedes.why: declares the authorized QA engine site (engine rule for any case that creates cloud data); the new QA_ site is the case's own, allowed by the offline-sites rule of 2026-11-03
